nvitk.segmentation.total_segmentator.class_maps¶

TotalSegmentator task class maps.

This module mirrors the upstream TotalSegmentator v2 class taxonomy, as captured in the legacy BioImaging/src/values.py. Every numeric label ID matches the order used by TotalSegmentator’s multi-label outputs so that downstream mask extraction can look up by integer directly (no extra name→id lookup table is needed).

Contents¶

  • CLASS_MAPS — task-name → {id: class_name} dict.

  • AVAILABLE_TASKS — tuple of every task key in CLASS_MAPS.

  • CLASS_MAP_5_PARTS — TotalSegmentator CT “5 parts” grouping.

  • CLASS_MAP_PARTS_MR — TotalSegmentator MR parts grouping.

  • CLASS_MAP_PARTS_HEADNECK_MUSCLES — head/neck muscle parts grouping.

  • MAP_TASKID_TO_PARTNAME_CT / _MR / _HEADNECK_MUSCLES — nnU-Net task-id → part-name lookup tables (upstream project metadata).

  • COMMERCIAL_MODELS — upstream commercial model ids; metadata only.

The helper accessors get_class_map(), get_class_id() and get_class_name() have not changed in shape; they dispatch through CLASS_MAPS.
